question: On 32 wholly fresh, independent Mystery Path worlds, can a non-gradient fixed numeric memory trained on real source-observed 16-step action consequences select a *single* beneficial 16-step macro from public RGB histories better than fully trained GRU/MLP, ridge, kNN, conventional count and random controls?
rationale: FKP14 source branchability HEADROOM PASS; FKP13 immediate online memory failed strong controls; FKP15-B original development INVALID_PRIMARY_HARNESS due reading nonexistent future label at FIRST held seed975500 anchor0 public reset, before any future branch or return score. FKP15-A separately preregistered overlapping cohorts and failed before collecting any source, therefore FKP16 uses wholly disjoint prospective held development worlds, no reused first-use claim.

frozen_source_method: One deterministic PUBLIC 8-step macro source-blind prefix Random(seed XOR 0xF15A0) at anchors (0,16,32,64); exact original source.reset/step and public RGB/action/reward/done prefix identity across 9 3×3 native macro actions each physically repeated up to16 steps. Real source future_return is signed sum; positive rewards and goal events recorded separately; 16-step return evaluator best-of-nine is retrospective privileged-only, never a learned model baseline.
frozen_features: Exactly original FKP15-B 204 float public per-frame pooled RGB 8×8×3 (192) plus last actually executed public action one-hot9 plus last truly observed reward sign one-hot3, full prefix sequence to GRU, mean of most recent up to8 frames to static models. At DEV only unlabeled public feature sequence+summary passed to each predictor; NO future return target or unchosen alternative branch labels permitted until ALL chosen actions are sealed.
candidate: Unmodified FKP15-B two-view 4096×9 int32 direct summed 1000×real TRAIN 16-step return and int32 visit count memory, 294,912 raw bytes, non-gradient numeric writes, smoothing to TRAIN per-action means. Frozen on new DEV, bit-exact restored and tamper test.
strong_controls: Unmodified FKP15-B one-hash 4096×9 count/return memory, GRU hidden64 full public prefix sequence and MLP 64×64 summary, each fully train 24 complete Adam epochs EACH of fixed seeds 1515 & 2626 (VAL-only lowest nine-return MSE checkpoint). Also regularized TRAIN ridge alpha(0.01,1,100), kNN (k1,5,15), selected on VAL nine-return MSE; TRAIN prior, deterministic world-anchor RANDOM and TRAIN-label-shuffled direct negative. Identical TRAIN source action/target opportunities. GRU gets longer temporal observation representation; whole-process FLOP equality unverified.
frozen_metric: Source-native actual real 16-step return of each model's SINGLE chosen macro per valid DEV anchor, paired by 32 independent DEV world clusters (four anchors/world); compare candidate against strongest conventional/fitted/negative, reselect strongest per each of 10,000 world-bootstrap samples seed1515. Also per-action positive rate, terminal goals, source costs/resets, oracle regret as unattainable ceiling, cold snapshot and model-selection SHA.
frozen_success: Only DEV_ACTION_VALUE_SIGNAL if candidate average earned return is at least +0.05 above best strong control, with 95% paired-world-bootstrap lower bound strictly>0, improvement in privilege-oracle regret of >=0.10 vs strongest, no positive-return action rate regression, >=24 valid independent DEV worlds, >0.05 genuine source hindsight-oracle vs deterministic random headroom, exact cold bit restore and corruption negative. These are preset; zero goals reported but not threshold due FKP14 rarity.
science_boundary: Even positive public DEV is not SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native acceptance; untouched independent source family, real adaptive multi-step interventions, unfamiliar-law transfer, cold interference, strong compute-matched conventional controls and independent owner-protected first-use separately required. No tuning, duplicate PR, paid APIs, accepted main/controller/runner/scheduler changes.
qualification: Before new source DEV: implement a first-use-safe unlabeled GRU+MLP prediction path; tests MUST pass a mocked end-to-end run() that withholds *all* 'returns' keys from prefix predictions, validates both valid and early-terminal source action counting, fits all conventional models, runs full result serializer and receipt steps. Freeze code/SHA/prereg and G29 source-atlas; qualify focused, G29 and mandatory inherited full regression on Ubuntu24.04 and Windows2022 BEFORE original fresh DEV. Reuse old TRAIN/VAL only as already-consumed training data; no FKP15 old DEV rerun. One fresh Linux source DEV then Windows only consumed source replay and exact final whole-regression; raw original archive and negative outcomes preserved.
